Text: Vaibhav is a very talented person. It is a very rare occassion that you come accross such individual and have the priviledge to work with. From working as a team member with valuable contributions in the in the IKON v8 project to coming out of his comfort zone and lead the project single handedly. All this happened in a course of just couple of months. Besides being outrightly talented Vaibhav I have observed has the skill of being politely outspoken when situation comes. He is the perfect blend of talent and confidence. I wish him all the best on his long and rewarding career ahead.
Subhankar is an excellent resource for the project.He is very detail oriented and technically very sound.I would surely recommend him for the next stint.

Sanghamitra is a hidden talent with lots of energy.She takes up new assignments with great zeal and accomplishes them with great ownership and responsibility.She is extremely polite in workplace and is a great team player.I would surely recommend her for her next endeavour

Amitava is a great team player,calm and composed and approaches every problem with an analytical bent of mind.His analytical skills has gone to great lengths in enhancing the product from time to time.His coding abilities are highly recommendable.

Simanchal is a great team member to work with.He has excellent coding and problem solving skills.He takes all problems sportingly and finds out the perfect solution.I wish him with all success for his future.
